075        public static float PROB_ARMS_DEALER_BAR = 0.25f;
076        public static float PROB_MILITARY_BAR = 0.33f;
077        public static float PROB_INDEPENDENT_BAR = 0.5f;
078        
079        public static float PROB_ARMS_DEALER_IS_CONTACT = 0.05f;
080        
081        public static float MIN_CAPACITY = 100000;
082        public static float MAX_CAPACITY = 500000;
083        public static int BAR_CAPACITY_BONUS_MIN = 50000;
084        public static int BAR_CAPACITY_BONUS_MAX = 150000;
085        
086        
087        public static float MAX_PROD_CAPACITY_AT_SHIP_UNITS = 10;
088        public static float MAX_PROD_CAPACITY_MULT = 0.25f;
089        
090        public static float DEALER_MIN_CAPACITY = 1000000;
091        public static float DEALER_MAX_CAPACITY = 2000000;
092        public static Map<PersonImportance, Float> DEALER_MULT = new LinkedHashMap<PersonImportance, Float>();
093        static {
094                DEALER_MULT.put(PersonImportance.VERY_LOW, 0.3f);
095                DEALER_MULT.put(PersonImportance.LOW, 0.3f);
096                DEALER_MULT.put(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, 0.3f);
097                DEALER_MULT.put(PersonImportance.HIGH, 0.6f);
098                DEALER_MULT.put(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH, 1f);
099        }

101        public static float MILITARY_CAP_MULT = 0.6f;
102

104        public static float TRADE_MAX_COST_INCREASE = 0.3f;
105        public static float DEALER_FIXED_COST_INCREASE = 0.5f;
106        public static float DEALER_VARIABLE_COST_INCREASE = 0.5f;

127        @Override
128        protected boolean create(MarketAPI createdAt, boolean barEvent) {
129                //genRandom = Misc.random;
130                
131                boolean allowArmsDealer = true; // anywhere is fine
132                boolean allowTrader = createdAt != null && createdAt.getCommodityData(Commodities.SHIPS).getMaxSupply() > 0;
133                boolean allowMilitary = allowTrader && createdAt != null && Misc.isMilitary(createdAt);
134                if (createdAt.isPlayerOwned()) {
135                        allowTrader = false;
136                        allowMilitary = false;
137                }
138                if (Factions.PIRATES.equals(createdAt.getFaction().getId())) {
139                        allowMilitary = false;
140                }
141                
142                if (barEvent) {
143                        String post = null;
144                        if (rollProbability(PROB_ARMS_DEALER_BAR) && allowArmsDealer) {
145                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
146                                post = Ranks.POST_ARMS_DEALER;
147                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
148                                setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
149                        } else if (rollProbability(PROB_MILITARY_BAR) && allowMilitary) {
150                                List<String> posts = new ArrayList<String>();
151                                posts.add(Ranks.POST_SUPPLY_OFFICER);
152                                if (Misc.isMilitary(createdAt)) {
153                                        posts.add(Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER);
154                                }
155                                if (Misc.hasOrbitalStation(createdAt)) {
156                                        posts.add(Ranks.POST_STATION_COMMANDER);
157                                }
158                                post = pickOne(posts);
159                                setGiverRank(pickOne(Ranks.GROUND_CAPTAIN, Ranks.GROUND_COLONEL, Ranks.GROUND_MAJOR,
160                                                         Ranks.SPACE_COMMANDER, Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN, Ranks.SPACE_ADMIRAL));
161                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY);
162                        } else if (allowTrader) {
163                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
164                                post = pickOne(Ranks.POST_TRADER, Ranks.POST_COMMODITIES_AGENT, Ranks.POST_PORTMASTER,
165                                                           Ranks.POST_MERCHANT, Ranks.POST_INVESTOR, Ranks.POST_EXECUTIVE,
166                                                           Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE, Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR);
167                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE);
168                                if (rollProbability(PROB_INDEPENDENT_BAR)) {
169                                        setGiverFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
170                                }
171                        }
172                        if (post == null && allowArmsDealer) {
173                                setGiverRank(Ranks.CITIZEN);
174                                post = Ranks.POST_ARMS_DEALER;
175                                setGiverTags(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
176                                setGiverFaction(Factions.PIRATES);
177                        }
178                        if (post == null) return false;
179                        
180                        setGiverPost(post);
181                        if (post.equals(Ranks.POST_SENIOR_EXECUTIVE) ||
182                                        post.equals(Ranks.POST_BASE_COMMANDER) ||
183                                        post.equals(Ranks.POST_ADMINISTRATOR)) {
184                                setGiverImportance(pickHighImportance());
185                        } else if (post.equals(Ranks.POST_ARMS_DEALER)) {
186                                setGiverImportance(pickArmsDealerImportance());
187                        } else {
188                                setGiverImportance(pickImportance());
189                                
190                        }
191                        findOrCreateGiver(createdAt, false, false);
192                        setGiverIsPotentialContactOnSuccess();
193                }
194                
195                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
196                if (person == null) return false;
197                
198                if (!setPersonMissionRef(person, "$cpc_ref")) {
199                        return false;
200                }
201                
202                market = getPerson().getMarket();
203                if (market == null) return false;
204                if (Misc.getStorage(market) == null) return false;
205                
206                faction = person.getFaction();
207                
208//              armsDealer = Ranks.POST_ARMS_DEALER.equals(person.getPostId());
209//              if (!armsDealer) allowArmsDealer = false;
210                armsDealer = getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_UNDERWORLD);
211
212                maxCapacity = getRoundNumber(MIN_CAPACITY + (MAX_CAPACITY - MIN_CAPACITY) * getQuality());
213                if (barEvent) {
214                        maxCapacity += genRoundNumber(BAR_CAPACITY_BONUS_MIN, BAR_CAPACITY_BONUS_MAX);
215                }
216                float capMult = market.getCommodityData(Commodities.SHIPS).getMaxSupply() / MAX_PROD_CAPACITY_AT_SHIP_UNITS;
217                if (capMult > 1) capMult = 1f;
218                if (capMult < MAX_PROD_CAPACITY_MULT) capMult = MAX_PROD_CAPACITY_MULT;
219                maxCapacity *= capMult;
220                if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY) && allowMilitary) {
221                        maxCapacity *= MILITARY_CAP_MULT;
222                }
223                maxCapacity = getRoundNumber(maxCapacity);
224                
225                if (armsDealer && allowArmsDealer) { // don't care about ship production, since it's just acquisition from wherever
226                        PersonImportance imp = getPerson().getImportance();
227                        float mult = DEALER_MULT.get(imp);
228                        maxCapacity = getRoundNumber(mult * 
229                                                (DEALER_MIN_CAPACITY + (DEALER_MAX_CAPACITY - DEALER_MIN_CAPACITY) * getQuality()));
230                }
231                
232                float extendedMult = Misc.isExtended() ? Global.getSettings().getFloat("ext_barCustomProductionMaxValueMult") : 1f;
233                maxCapacity *= extendedMult;
234                
235                if (armsDealer && allowArmsDealer) {
236                        costMult = 1f + DEALER_FIXED_COST_INCREASE + DEALER_VARIABLE_COST_INCREASE * (1f - getRewardMultFraction());
237                        addArmsDealerBlueprints();
238                        if (ships.isEmpty() && weapons.isEmpty() && fighters.isEmpty()) return false;
239                } else if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY) && allowMilitary) {
240                        costMult = 1f - MILITARY_MAX_COST_DECREASE * getRewardMultFraction();
241                        addMilitaryBlueprints();
242                        if (ships.isEmpty() && weapons.isEmpty() && fighters.isEmpty()) return false;
243                } else if (person.hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE) && allowTrader) {
244                        costMult = 1f + TRADE_MAX_COST_INCREASE * (1f - getRewardMultFraction());
245                } else {
246                        return false;
247                }
248
249                setStartingStage(Stage.WAITING);
250                setSuccessStage(Stage.DELIVERED);
251                setFailureStage(Stage.FAILED);
252                setNoAbandon();
253                
254                connectWithDaysElapsed(Stage.WAITING, Stage.DELIVERED, PROD_DAYS);
255                //connectWithDaysElapsed(Stage.WAITING, Stage.DELIVERED, 1f);
256                setStageOnMarketDecivilized(Stage.FAILED, market);
257                
258                return true;
259        }

262        protected void addArmsDealerBlueprints() {
263                boolean [] add = new boolean[3];
264                add[genRandom.nextInt(add.length)] = true;
265                add[genRandom.nextInt(add.length)] = true;
266                add[genRandom.nextInt(add.length)] = true;
267                
268                PersonImportance imp = getPerson().getImportance();
269                if (imp == PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH) {
270                        add[0] = true;
271                        add[1] = true;
272                        add[2] = true;
273                }
274
275                Set<WeaponType> wTypes = new LinkedHashSet<WeaponAPI.WeaponType>();
276                Set<WeaponSize> wSizes = new LinkedHashSet<WeaponAPI.WeaponSize>();
277                Set<HullSize> hullSizes = new LinkedHashSet<HullSize>();
278
279                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponType> wTypePicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponType>(genRandom);
280                wTypePicker.add(WeaponType.BALLISTIC);
281                wTypePicker.add(WeaponType.ENERGY);
282                wTypePicker.add(WeaponType.MISSILE);
283                WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSize> wSizePicker = new WeightedRandomPicker<WeaponSize>(genRandom);
284                wSizePicker.add(WeaponSize.SMALL);
285                wSizePicker.add(WeaponSize.MEDIUM);
286                wSizePicker.add(WeaponSize.LARGE);
287                
288                int nWeapons = 0;
289                int nShips = 0;
290                int nFighters = 0;
291                
292                switch (imp) {
293                case VERY_LOW:
294                        add[1] = true;
295                        wSizes.add(WeaponSize.SMALL);
296                        wTypes.add(wTypePicker.pickAndRemove());
297                        nWeapons = 5 + genRandom.nextInt(6);
298                        nFighters = 1 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
299                        break;
300                case LOW:
301                        add[1] = true;
302                        wSizePicker.remove(WeaponSize.LARGE);
303                        wSizes.add(wSizePicker.pickAndRemove());
304                        wTypes.add(wTypePicker.pickAndRemove());
305                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
306                        nWeapons = 10 + genRandom.nextInt(6);
307                        nShips = 5 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
308                        nFighters = 3 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
309                        break;
310//              case LOW:
311//              case VERY_LOW:
312                case MEDIUM:
313                        add[1] = true;
314                        wSizes.add(wSizePicker.pickAndRemove());
315                        wSizes.add(wSizePicker.pickAndRemove());
316                        wTypes.add(wTypePicker.pickAndRemove());
317                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
318                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.DESTROYER);
319                        nWeapons = 20 + genRandom.nextInt(6);
320                        nShips = 10 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
321                        nFighters = 5 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
322                        break;
323                case HIGH:
324                        add[1] = true;
325                        wSizes.add(wSizePicker.pickAndRemove());
326                        wSizes.add(wSizePicker.pickAndRemove());
327                        wTypes.add(wTypePicker.pickAndRemove());
328                        wTypes.add(wTypePicker.pickAndRemove());
329                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
330                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.DESTROYER);
331                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.CRUISER);
332                        nWeapons = 20 + genRandom.nextInt(6);
333                        nShips = 10 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
334                        nFighters = 7 + genRandom.nextInt(3);
335                        break;
336                case VERY_HIGH:
337                        wSizes.add(WeaponSize.SMALL);
338                        wSizes.add(WeaponSize.MEDIUM);
339                        wSizes.add(WeaponSize.LARGE);
340                        
341                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.FRIGATE);
342                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.DESTROYER);
343                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.CRUISER);
344                        hullSizes.add(HullSize.CAPITAL_SHIP);
345                        
346                        wTypes.add(WeaponType.BALLISTIC);
347                        wTypes.add(WeaponType.ENERGY);
348                        wTypes.add(WeaponType.MISSILE);
349                        nWeapons = 1000;
350                        nShips = 1000;
351                        nFighters = 1000;
352                        break;
353                }
354                
355
356                FactionProductionAPI prod = Global.getSector().getPlayerFaction().getProduction().clone();
357                prod.clear();
358                
359                if (add[0]) {
360                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
361                        for (ShipHullSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllShipHullSpecs()) {
362                                //if (!spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_RARE_BP) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
363                                if (spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_NO_DEALER)) continue;
364                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
365                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.RESTRICTED)) continue;
366                                if (spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.HIDE_IN_CODEX)) continue;
367                                if (spec.getHints().contains(ShipTypeHints.UNBOARDABLE)) continue;
368                                if (spec.isDefaultDHull()) continue; // || spec.isDHull()) continue;
369                                if (spec.isDHullOldMethod()) continue;
370                                if ("shuttlepod".equals(spec.getHullId())) continue;
371                                if (ships.contains(spec.getHullId())) continue;
372                                if (!hullSizes.contains(spec.getHullSize())) continue;
373                                float cost = prod.createSampleItem(ProductionItemType.SHIP, spec.getHullId(), 1).getBaseCost();
374                                cost = (int)Math.round(cost * costMult);
375                                if (cost > maxCapacity) continue;
376                                picker.add(spec.getHullId(), 10f);
377                        }
378//                      int num = 2 + (int)Math.round(genRandom.nextInt(5) * getQuality());
379//                      num += imp.ordinal() * 2;
380//                      if (imp == PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH) num = 1000;
381                        int num = nShips;
382                        for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
383                                ships.add(picker.pickAndRemove());
384                        }
385                }
386                
387                if (add[1]) {
388                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
389                        for (WeaponSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllWeaponSpecs()) {
390                                //if (!spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_RARE_BP) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
391                                if (spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_NO_DEALER)) continue;
392                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
393                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.RESTRICTED)) continue;
394                                if (spec.getAIHints().contains(AIHints.SYSTEM)) continue;
395                                if (weapons.contains(spec.getWeaponId())) continue;
396                                if (!wTypes.contains(spec.getType())) continue;
397                                if (!wSizes.contains(spec.getSize())) continue;
398                                float cost = prod.createSampleItem(ProductionItemType.WEAPON, spec.getWeaponId(), 1).getBaseCost();
399                                cost = (int)Math.round(cost * costMult);
400                                if (cost > maxCapacity) continue;
401                                picker.add(spec.getWeaponId(), 10f);
402                        }
403//                      int num = 3 + (int)Math.round(genRandom.nextInt(7) * getQuality());
404//                      num += imp.ordinal() * 2;
405//                      if (imp == PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH) num = 1000;
406                        int num = nWeapons;
407                        for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
408                                weapons.add(picker.pickAndRemove());
409                        }
410                }
411                
412                if (add[2]) {
413                        WeightedRandomPicker<String> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<String>(genRandom);
414                        for (FighterWingSpecAPI spec : Global.getSettings().getAllFighterWingSpecs()) {
415                                //if (!spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_RARE_BP) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
416//                              if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) continue;
417//                              if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
418                                if (spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_NO_DEALER)) continue;
419                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL) && !spec.hasTag(Items.TAG_DEALER)) continue;
420                                if (spec.hasTag(Tags.RESTRICTED)) continue;
421                                if (fighters.contains(spec.getId())) continue;
422                                float cost = prod.createSampleItem(ProductionItemType.FIGHTER, spec.getId(), 1).getBaseCost();
423                                cost = (int)Math.round(cost * costMult);
424                                if (cost > maxCapacity) continue;
425                                picker.add(spec.getId(), 10f);
426                        }
427//                      int num = 1 + (int)Math.round(genRandom.nextInt(3) * getQuality());
428//                      num += imp.ordinal() * 2;
429//                      if (imp == PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH) num = 1000;
430                        int num = nFighters;
431                        for (int i = 0; i < num && !picker.isEmpty(); i++) {
432                                fighters.add(picker.pickAndRemove());
433                        }
434                }
435        }

437        protected void addMilitaryBlueprints() {
438                for (String id : faction.getKnownShips()) {
439                        ShipHullSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getHullSpec(id);
440                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
441                        if (spec.isDHullOldMethod()) continue;
442                        //if (spec.isDHull()) continue;
443                        ships.add(id);
444                }
445                for (String id : faction.getKnownWeapons()) {
446                        WeaponSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getWeaponSpec(id);
447                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) continue;
448                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
449                        weapons.add(id);
450                }
451                for (String id : faction.getKnownFighters()) {
452                        FighterWingSpecAPI spec = Global.getSettings().getFighterWingSpec(id);
453                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_DROP)) continue;
454                        if (spec.hasTag(Tags.NO_SELL)) continue;
455                        fighters.add(id);
456                }
457        }

460        protected void updateInteractionDataImpl() {
461                set("$cpc_military", getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_MILITARY));
462                set("$cpc_trade", getPerson().hasTag(Tags.CONTACT_TRADE));
463                set("$cpc_armsDealer", armsDealer);
464                
465                set("$cpc_barEvent", isBarEvent());
466                set("$cpc_manOrWoman", getPerson().getManOrWoman());
467                set("$cpc_maxCapacity", Misc.getWithDGS(maxCapacity));
468                set("$cpc_costPercent", (int)Math.round(costMult * 100f) + "%");
469                set("$cpc_days", "" + (int) PROD_DAYS);
470        }

472        @Override
473        public void addDescriptionForCurrentStage(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
474                float opad = 10f;
475                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
476                if (currentStage == Stage.WAITING) {
477                        float elapsed = getElapsedInCurrentStage();
478                        int d = (int) Math.round(PROD_DAYS - elapsed);
479                        PersonAPI person = getPerson();
480                        
481                        LabelAPI label = info.addPara("The order will be delivered to storage " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
482                                        " in %s " + getDayOrDays(d) + ".", opad,
483                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + d);
484                        label.setHighlight(market.getName(), "" + d);
485                        label.setHighlightColors(market.getFaction().getBaseUIColor(), h);
486                        
487                        //intel.createSmallDescription(info, width, height);
488                        showCargoContents(info, width, height);
489                        
490                        
491                } else if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVERED) {
492                        float elapsed = getElapsedInCurrentStage();
493                        int d = (int) Math.round(elapsed);
494                        LabelAPI label = info.addPara("The order was delivered to storage " + market.getOnOrAt() + " " + market.getName() + 
495                                        " %s " + getDayOrDays(d) + " ago.", opad,
496                                        Misc.getHighlightColor(), "" + d);
497                        label.setHighlight(market.getName(), "" + d);
498                        label.setHighlightColors(market.getFaction().getBaseUIColor(), h);
499                        
500                        showCargoContents(info, width, height);
501                        addDeleteButton(info, width);
502                } else if (currentStage == Stage.FAILED) {
503                        if (market.hasCondition(Conditions.DECIVILIZED)) {
504                                info.addPara("This order will not be completed because %s" + 
505                                                " has decivilized.", opad,
506                                                faction.getBaseUIColor(), market.getName());
507                        } else {
508                                info.addPara("You've learned that this order will not be completed.", opad);
509                        }
510                }
511        }

541        @Override
542        public void acceptImpl(InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
543                float f = (float) cost / (float) maxCapacity;
544                float p = ContactIntel.DEFAULT_POTENTIAL_CONTACT_PROB * f;
545                if (armsDealer) {
546                        p = PROB_ARMS_DEALER_IS_CONTACT * f;
547                }
548                if (potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess != null) {
549                        for (PotentialContactData data : potentialContactsOnMissionSuccess) {
550                                data.probability = p;
551                        }
552                }
553                
554                AddRemoveCommodity.addCreditsLossText(cost, dialog.getTextPanel());
555                Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().subtract(cost);
556                adjustRep(dialog.getTextPanel(), null, RepActions.MISSION_SUCCESS);
557                addPotentialContacts(dialog);
558                
559                ships = null;
560                fighters = null;
561                weapons = null;
562        }

565        @Override
566        public void setCurrentStage(Object next, InteractionDialogAPI dialog, Map<String, MemoryAPI> memoryMap) {
567                super.setCurrentStage(next, dialog, memoryMap);
568                
569                if (currentStage == Stage.DELIVERED) {
570                        StoragePlugin plugin = (StoragePlugin) Misc.getStorage(getPerson().getMarket());
571                        if (plugin == null) return;
572                        plugin.setPlayerPaidToUnlock(true);
573                        
574                        CargoAPI cargo = plugin.getCargo();
575                        for (CargoAPI curr : data.data.values()) {
576                                cargo.addAll(curr, true);
577                        }
578                        
579                        //endSuccess(dialog, memoryMap);
580                        
581                        if (armsDealer && rollProbability(ARMS_DEALER_PROB_PATROL_AFTER)) {
582                                PersonAPI person = getPerson();
583                                if (person == null || person.getMarket() == null) return;
584                                String patrolFaction = person.getMarket().getFactionId();
585                                if (patrolFaction.equals(person.getFaction().getId()) || 
586                                                Misc.isPirateFaction(person.getMarket().getFaction()) ||
587                                                Misc.isDecentralized(person.getMarket().getFaction()) ||
588                                                patrolFaction.equals(Factions.PLAYER)) {
589                                        return;
590                                }
591                                
592                                DelayedFleetEncounter e = new DelayedFleetEncounter(genRandom, getMissionId());
593                                e.setDelayMedium();
594                                e.setLocationCoreOnly(true, patrolFaction);
595                                e.beginCreate();
596                                e.triggerCreateFleet(FleetSize.LARGE, FleetQuality.DEFAULT, patrolFaction, FleetTypes.PATROL_LARGE, new Vector2f());
597                                e.setFleetWantsThing(patrolFaction, 
598                                                "information regarding the arms dealer", "it",
599                                                "information concerning the activities of known arms dealer, " + person.getNameString(),
600                                                getRoundNumber(cost / 2),
601                                                false, ComplicationRepImpact.FULL,
602                                                DelayedFleetEncounter.TRIGGER_REP_LOSS_HIGH, getPerson());
603                                e.triggerSetAdjustStrengthBasedOnQuality(true, getQuality());
604                                e.triggerSetPatrol();
605                                e.triggerSetStandardAggroInterceptFlags();
606                                e.endCreate();
607                        }
608                }
609        }

669        protected void convertProdToCargo(FactionProductionAPI prod) {
670                cost = prod.getTotalCurrentCost();
671                data = new ProductionData();
672                CargoAPI cargo = data.getCargo("Order manifest");
673                
674                float quality = ShipQuality.getShipQuality(market, market.getFactionId());
675                if (armsDealer) {
676                        quality = Math.max(quality, 1.5f); // high enough (with some margin, at that) for no d-mods
677                }
678
679                CampaignFleetAPI ships = Global.getFactory().createEmptyFleet(market.getFactionId(), "temp", true);
680                ships.setCommander(Global.getSector().getPlayerPerson());
681                ships.getFleetData().setShipNameRandom(genRandom);
682                DefaultFleetInflaterParams p = new DefaultFleetInflaterParams();
683                p.quality = quality;
684                p.mode = ShipPickMode.PRIORITY_THEN_ALL;
685                p.persistent = false;
686                p.seed = genRandom.nextLong();
687                p.timestamp = null;
688                p.blockHullmodsWithItemReqs = true;
689                
690                FleetInflater inflater = Misc.getInflater(ships, p);
691                ships.setInflater(inflater);
692                
693                for (ItemInProductionAPI item : prod.getCurrent()) {
694                        int count = item.getQuantity();
695                                
696                        if (item.getType() == ProductionItemType.SHIP) {
697                                for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
698                                        ships.getFleetData().addFleetMember(item.getSpecId() + "_Hull");
699                                }
700                        } else if (item.getType() == ProductionItemType.FIGHTER) {
701                                cargo.addFighters(item.getSpecId(), count);
702                        } else if (item.getType() == ProductionItemType.WEAPON) {
703                                cargo.addWeapons(item.getSpecId(), count);
704                        }
705                }
706                
707                // so that it adds d-mods
708                ships.inflateIfNeeded();
709                for (FleetMemberAPI member : ships.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy()) {
710                        // it should be due to the inflateIfNeeded() call, this is just a safety check
711                        if (member.getVariant().getSource() == VariantSource.REFIT) {
712                                member.getVariant().clear();
713                        }
714                        cargo.getMothballedShips().addFleetMember(member);
715                }
716        }

718        public void showCargoContents(TooltipMakerAPI info, float width, float height) {
719                if (data == null) return;
720                
721                Color h = Misc.getHighlightColor();
722                Color g = Misc.getGrayColor();
723                Color tc = Misc.getTextColor();
724                float pad = 3f;
725                float small = 3f;
726                float opad = 10f;
727
728                List<String> keys = new ArrayList<String>(data.data.keySet());
729                Collections.sort(keys, new Comparator<String>() {
730                        public int compare(String o1, String o2) {
731                                return o1.compareTo(o2);
732                        }
733                });
734                
735                for (String key : keys) {
736                        CargoAPI cargo = data.data.get(key);
737                        if (cargo.isEmpty() && 
738                                        ((cargo.getMothballedShips() == null || 
739                                          cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()))) {
740                                continue;
741                        }
742                
743                        info.addSectionHeading(key, faction.getBaseUIColor(), faction.getDarkUIColor(), 
744                                                                   Alignment.MID, opad);
745                        
746                        if (!cargo.getStacksCopy().isEmpty()) {
747                                info.addPara("Ship weapons and fighters:", opad);
748                                info.showCargo(cargo, 20, true, opad);
749                        }
750                        
751                        if (!cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy().isEmpty()) {
752                                CountingMap<String> counts = new CountingMap<String>();
753                                for (FleetMemberAPI member : cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy()) {
754                                        counts.add(member.getVariant().getHullSpec().getHullName() + " " + member.getVariant().getDesignation());
755                                }
756                                
757                                info.addPara("Ship hulls:", opad);
758                                info.showShips(cargo.getMothballedShips().getMembersListCopy(), 20, true,
759                                                           getCurrentStage() == Stage.WAITING, opad);
760                        }
761                }
762        }

764        public PersonImportance pickArmsDealerImportance() {
765                WeightedRandomPicker<PersonImportance> picker = new WeightedRandomPicker<PersonImportance>(genRandom);
766                
767//              picker.add(PersonImportance.VERY_LOW, 10f);
768//              picker.add(PersonImportance.LOW, 10f);
769                picker.add(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, 10f);
770                
771//              int credits = (int) Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getCargo().getCredits().get();
772//              if (credits >= 200000) {
773//                      picker.add(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, 10f);
774//              }
775//              if (credits >= 1000000) {
776//                      picker.add(PersonImportance.HIGH, 10f);
777//              }
778//              if (credits >= 200000) {
779//                      picker.add(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH, 10f);
780//              }
781                
782                float cycles = PirateBaseManager.getInstance().getDaysSinceStart() / 365f;
783                if (cycles > 1f) {
784//                      picker.remove(PersonImportance.VERY_LOW);
785//                      picker.add(PersonImportance.MEDIUM, 20f);
786                        picker.add(PersonImportance.HIGH, 5f);
787                }
788                if (cycles > 3f) {
789//                      picker.remove(PersonImportance.LOW);
790//                      picker.add(PersonImportance.HIGH, 10f);
791                        picker.remove(PersonImportance.MEDIUM);
792                        picker.add(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH, 5f);
793                }
794                if (cycles > 5f) {
795                        //picker.add(PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH, 10f);
796                        // always very high importance past a certain point, since the goal is to allow easier procurement
797                        // of almost any "generally available" hull
798                        return PersonImportance.VERY_HIGH;
799                }
800                
801                return picker.pick();
802        }
